notes.title: Stranded Deep 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

[h3][b]Today marks the 1.0 release of Stranded Deep![/b][/h3]

The release of 1.0 represents that [i]Stranded Deep[/i] is feature complete. We’ve achieved our high-level goals and are now focusing on stability and quality-of-life fixes. We have some remaining multiplayer issues to fix and we have a dedicated team working on fixing these.

We’d like to take a moment to thank everyone who has supported us. The game and community has grown far beyond anything we ever could have expected. Ben and I originally started this project out of our back rooms. We had no previous industry experience, we were just two kids with a cool idea who wanted to make their first game. I remember the Steam Greenlight concept with the little raft on the ocean… we never could have guessed the community would get behind it the way they did. It has grown beyond our wildest dreams.

We’ve met some amazing people along the way. We’ve made friends with the teams at Funlabs and Abstraction who worked hard to bring the game to consoles. It’s also been a great experience working with the big first parties and the people behind them. Everyone at Steam, Epic, Sony, Microsoft and Nintendo has been great to work with and they’ve given us opportunities that we never would have dreamed of. And of course, our publishing brothers at North Beach Games who have been with us since 2015 and supported us every step of the way. All of you have helped grow Stranded Deep into something bigger than the two of us ever could have expected. You’ve enabled us to secure our future as a studio and we’re looking forward to taking everything we’ve learned from this experience and using it to grow bigger and better. We’re forever grateful.

Thanks so much again to everyone who has been a part of the journey. 

Stay Alive! 
— Beam Team

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]- Fixed host and/or client crashing when returning to the main menu after completing the endgame scene.

notes.title: Update 0.90.04!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

[h3][b][i]A new stable build (0.90.04) is now live![/i][/b][/h3]

Thanks so much to everyone who has been a part of Stranded Deep’s online co-op launch. We’ve really enjoyed watching the new content from creators and the community feedback on the forums has been invaluable. 
  
The big focus for this patch has been fixing connectivity issues and issues reported by the community. Several important issues have been fixed which will significantly reduce the number of desyncs and disconnects and improve overall stability. We have a few known issues, mostly related to the ‘join-in-progress' feature. If you experience desyncs, we recommend quitting and re-joining in the lobby for now while we work to fix the remaining issues.
  
– Beam Team

[h3][b]EXTRA PATCH NOTES[/b][/h3][h3][b]0.76.00-0.80.00 Stable Change Log[/b][/h3][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]- Changed ‘Play’ button to enter New Game menu if no save game available to continue.

notes.title: Update 0.80.00! New Item Piles and Storage Improvements!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

[h3][i][b]A new stable build (0.80.00) is live![/b][/i][/h3]

The 0.80.00 update transitions our recent work on the experimental branch to the stable branch, including the new [b][i]Piles[/i][/b], [b][i]Inventory[/i][/b] improvements, quality-of-life changes, bug fixes and polish.

This build features some changes and improvements to the [b][i]Inventory[/i][/b] mechanics. We recognized that the idea of your hands acting as an extra ‘slot’ for your held item and not being visible in the inventory was confusing. This mechanic also made it difficult to transfer held items into storage. Now the item you’re holding is displayed in the first inventory slot. The slot to the left of this is reserved for other inventory actions, like empty hands, or navigating between storage.

This build also adds the ability to craft [b][i]Piles[/i][/b] of items. This is part of our recent work to encourage organization and discourage players from gathering large piles of items that negatively affect performance. We know there is a reward and feeling of satisfaction from accruing large piles of stuff, so we don’t want to take that away! ‘Piles’ are an efficient way to show off your hoarding skills! See the patch notes for more info on how to use the new piles feature.

There’s also a very important fix for a frustrating bug where objects left on the Aircraft carrier would fall though when loading the zone.

Have fun :)

Stay Alive!
:: Beam Team
--

[h3][b]0.76.00-0.80.00 Stable Change Log[/b][/h3][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]

- Added new craftable item [b][i]Piles![/i][/b]

You can create a pile by looking at or holding an item that you have 2 or more of in the surrounding area. Use the Quick Craft menu to craft a ‘pile’ of that item, which is shown by a new pile icon in blue. Piles are free to create and store 1 type of crafting item. So far, the supported items are: Sticks, Rocks, Palm Fonds, Lashings, Fibrous Leaves, Clay and Logs. The capacity for most items is 50x, but can vary depending on the item.

You withdraw and deposit items just like a storage container. The first item stored assigns the type of pile it is. You can remove all items and re-assign a pile at any time. When you withdraw all items from a pile, it will simply disappear.

Items stored in a pile are available and can be used when crafting without having to manually remove them from a pile. Note: Pile materials will be used last. 

We’re still fine-tuning the mechanics; the pile’s physics collider currently adapts to the quantity and size of items, which is nice for player collisions, but there may be some issues there if players stack other objects on top of piles…

For those interested in the tech side of things, the benefits of the new piles are:
- Faster zone loading: 1 item to load, instead of 50x individual objects.
- Batched rendering for 50x items. Rendering multiple items was batched before, but the new method is even more efficient.
- Less physics overhead! Piles are a static object with 1 collider, instead of 50x physics bodies and colliders.
- Less overhead from individual Unity GameObjects. GameObjects and Components in Unity incur a small amount of overhead to validate state and run callbacks on every instance. This all adds up, so is good to mitigate.

[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]- Increased [b][i]Storage Container[/i][/b] slots from 3  5.
- Increased [b][i]Inventory[/i][/b] slots from 10  12.
- Changed [b][i]Inventory[/i][/b] to display the item the player is holding in slot 1.
- Changed [b][i]Inventory[/i][/b] to pop an item that matches the sub-type if it can’t find a matching item of the full type, ie: a player will switch to holding a Crude spear after using all their Refined Spears.
- Changed [b][i]Inventory[/i][/b] drop action from secondary ‘click’ to ‘short press’ (only in menus)
- Changed [b][i]Wood Crates[/i][/b] to be craftable.
- Changed [b][i]Wood Crates[/i][/b] to refund materials.
- Changed ‘Play’ button to enter New Game menu if no save game available to continue. 
- Changed [b][i]Boat Motor[/i][/b] to function as a rudder when out of fuel.
- Changed [b][i]Medical Consumables[/i][/b] to refund Coconut Flasks after consuming. 
- Increased [b][i]Meat[/i][/b] inventory capacity from 4 to 8. 
- Increased [b][i]Fish[/i][/b] inventory capacity from 4 to 8.
- Increased [b][i]Fruit[/i][/b] inventory capacity from 4 to 8.
- Added crafting placing controls on screen when placing.
- Improved [b][i]Pinned Crafting Combo[/i][/b] display. Changed pinned crafting combo UI to display craftsmanship skill level required to avoid confusion when a player has all materials, but skill is not high enough.
- Improved [b][i]Watch[/i][/b] feedback when displaying player [b][i]Skills[/i][/b]; Removed clamped values on skill bars making it easier to monitor skill progress.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]- Fixed objects on the extremities of large islands not being saved.
- Fixed physics objects falling through [b][i]Aircraft Carrier[/i][/b] when loading, ie: Gyro parts and supplies.
- Fixed [b][i]Storage[/i][/b] pointer drawing behind slot icons.
- Fixed [b][i]Tutorial[/i][/b] not resuming when re-loading. Please note this fix is not retro-active as old save files will be missing the completed objective data.
- Fixed [b][i]Projectiles[/i][/b] (spears, etc) drifting out of player hands when held.
- Fixed objects attached to [b][i]Spears[/i][/b] not saving if player holding spear.
- Fixed being able to place [b][i]Craftable[/i][/b] objects inside terrain rocks. The crafting ghost will snap to terrain rocks for visualization but placing is not allowed. Foliage does not affect placements.
- Fixed [b][i]Loading Screen[/i][/b] changing color between Boot and Main Menu scene.
- Fixed [b][i]Leaderboards[/i][/b] list not focusing active leaderboard button when scrolling with keys/controller.
- Fixed not being able to place [b][i]Water Bottles[/i][/b] when crafted.
- Fixed not being able to rotate some [b][i]Craftables[/i][/b] when placing, ie: Shelter, Furniture, etc.
- Fixed being able to place [b][i]Furniture[/i][/b] inside the terrain.
- Fixed [b][i]Foliage Spawner[/i][/b] losing track of player if travelling too fast.
- Fixed [b][i]Rafts[/i][/b] falling through other Rafts/pieces when crafting a new Raft piece.
- Fixed [b][i]Sea Anchor[/i][/b] able to deploy when overturned.

Hey everyone,

[h3][i][b]A new experimental build (0.72.00) is up![/b][/i][/h3]

This build features the new [b][i]Big World![/i][/b]

The new bigger world is twice the size of the previous world with more randomly positioned islands (no more fixed 5x5 grid).
The game will upgrade your existing world and save data to the new big world format. The upgrade is not destructive so you can roll back to the previous release and continue playing. The upgrade will backup your old save file and add a “_LEGACY” suffix to its file name. If you want to roll back you will just need to delete the newer upgraded save file and then remove the legacy suffix from your old save file. If something does go wrong during the upgrade process, please post a bug report so we can diagnose and fix the problem.

As always, we hope everyone is safe and healthy. It’s nice to think that Stranded Deep might provide a fun distraction for people during all of this craziness. Have fun :)

Stay Alive!
:: Beam Team

notes.title: 0.71.00 Experimental Update. New End Game!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

[h3][i][b]A new experimental build (0.71.00) is now live![/b][/i][/h3]

This build features the new [b][i]End Game Scenario![/i][/b] 

After much thought, we have decided to release the end game scenario on the experimental branch in its current state. Please be aware that our original plan was to release the end-game scenario after external QA testing as part of our final updates. We wanted to release it that way, instead of our usual experimental-->stable release cycle, as we felt it didn't make sense for such a high-impact scenario that needs to work right 1st time and isn't something that gets played over and over... However, there have been some strong opinions on the forum from some players who disagree and want it now. Ultimately, we’ve decided that the choice should be yours… We’re still in the shake-down process, tidying the loose ends and polishing the final sequence. Also note that there is a chance a future update could break any progress made towards completing the end-game. But disclaimers aside -- we’re excited to share it with you as we think it’s a pretty cool scenario that ties everything together. We’re also excited to hear what you think about the end sequence and any theories!

The new end game zone will be generated when creating a new world in the Cartographer. If you have an existing world and save file and don't want to create a new world, we've added the end game map as workshop content here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2096887376
Subscribe to this content and it will appear in your Community Maps in the Cartographer. Drag it into your existing world like any other map :)

Have fun!

Stay Alive!
:: Beam Team
--

notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

[h1][i][b]A new stable build 0.65.00 is up![/b][/i][/h1]

The new 0.65.00 update transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch, including new [b][i]Achievements[/i][/b], [b][i]Leaderboards[/i][/b], [b][i]Tutorial[/i][/b], [b][i]Localization[/i][/b], new [b][i]Hog[/i][/b] and [b][i]Giant Crab[/i][/b] animals and heaps more! Be sure to have a read of the patch notes below if you haven’t been playing on the experimental branch.

Have fun :)

Stay Alive!
:: Beam Team
–

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1] 
- Fixed [b][i]OpenGL[/i][/b] support for Windows builds. 
- Fixed [b][i]Boot[/i][/b] screen occasionally freezing.
- Fixed [b][i]Controller[/i][/b] assignments not reloading properly when using two controllers of same model.
- Fixed [b][i]Controller[/i][/b] assignments only loading for controllers connected at start.
- Fixed P1 and P2 [b][i]Controls[/i][/b] interfering with each other’s menus. 
- Fixed P1 crafting combo [b][i]Pinning[/i][/b] not working when P2 controller connected.
- Fixed [b][i]Main Menu[/i][/b] key/controller navigation.
- Fixed [b][i]New Game[/i][/b] menu key/controller button navigation.
- Fixed [b][i]Crafting Menu[/i][/b] key navigation not working
- Fixed progressive [b][i]Loading[/i][/b] not getting correct player speed, resulting in objects still being loaded in when you approach an island. Note: Using god mode may cause hitches as the speed is much faster than normal gameplay…
- Fixed performance hit from aerial camera in animated [b][i]Loading[/i][/b] scene.
- Fixed white overlay for players with item highlighting setting turned off.
- Fixed white overlay (over-exposure) when saving game.
- Fixed new games loading empty islands when all maps in world are custom.
- Fixed co-op character [b][i]Gender[/i][/b] not loading or assigning correctly.
- Fixed [b][i]Watches[/i][/b] not loading in co-op mode. 
- Fixed [b][i]Post FX[/i][/b] settings not loading properly.
- Fixed [b][i]Color Grading[/i][/b] post fx not working.
- Fixed [b][i]Hud[/i][/b] showing over [b][i]Watch[/i][/b].
- Fixed P1 [b][i]Notifications[/i][/b] showing for both players.
- Fixed player skill [b][i]Notification[/i][/b] not showing per-player.
- Fixed dark edges on [b][i]Volumetric Clouds[/i][/b].
- Fixed [b][i]Meat[/i][/b] objects missing shadows.
- Fixed [b][i]Paddle[/i][/b] not moving with raft when reloaded. 
- Fixed [b][i]Container Shelf[/i][/b] shelves not moving with the shelf. 
- Fixed [b][i]Container Shelf[/i][/b] not updating positions when removing an existing shelf.
- Fixed using items whilst climbing ladders and ledges. 
- Fixed [b][i]Water Still[/i][/b] not providing fluids when drank.
- Fixed [b][i]Fuel Still[/i][/b] not placing on foundations or floors.
- Fixed [b][i]Container Door[/i][/b] not refunding the correct object when destroyed.
- Fixed [b][i]Wood Floor[/i][/b] not being rotatable.
- Fixed [b][i]Roofs[/i][/b] occasionally unable to place next to each other.
- Fixed [b][i]Fish[/i][/b] preventing construction placement.
- Fixed [b][i]Fish[/i][/b] blocking item selection when picking up items.
- Fixed [b][i]Camera[/i][/b] flipping upside down when standing on rafts.
- Fixed [b][i]Volumetric Clouds[/i][/b] not working in map editor.
- Fixed not being able to place some crafted objects (during forced placing when Inventory full). 
- Fixed spelling mistake for craftsmanship skill notification.
- Fixed bug in options menu manifesting after using the map editor.

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1] 
- Improved [b][i]Loading[/i][/b] speed of zones when starting or loading a game. 
- Added ability to jump when swimming in shallow water.
- Added ability to [b][i]Sleep[/i][/b]in co-op mode. Note: Players much be near each other to save.
- Added damage effect to [b][i]Farming Plots[/i][/b].
- Added material refunding to [b][i]Farming Plots[/i][/b].
- Added chance of failure to [b][i]Fire Lighting[/i][/b].
- Changed [b][i]Fire Lighting[/i][/b] difficulty to be based on physical skill. 
- Changed [b][i]Breath Boost[/i][/b] and [b][i]Antidote[/i][/b] recipes to require only 1x plant.
- Changed [b][i]Boot[/i][/b] intro to allow skipping intro menu faster.
- Changed [b][i]Billboards[/i][/b] to match parent scale. Note: Custom editing of object scale is unsupported.
- Changed [b][i]Item Attack Animations[/i][/b] to only play if the object is damageable.
- Changed [b][i]Beds[/i][/b] to only allow sleeping at night.
- Changed [b][i]Beds[/i][/b] to always wakeup between 4am-7am.
- Changed [b][i]Smoker[/i][/b] size by decreasing it 30%.
- Changed [b][i]Crab [/i][/b] texture.
- Changed [b][i]Crabs[/i][/b] to respawn after 3 days.
- Changed [b][i]Boars[/i][/b] to respawn after 1 week.
- Changed [b][i]Snakes[/i][/b] to respawn after 1 week.

[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1] 

- Added new [b][i]Achievements![/i][/b]

- Added new [b][i]Leaderboards![/i][/b]

- Added new [b][i]Localization![/i][/b] 
Huge WIP. Including new controller glyphs for supported controllers.
Note: Any unsupported controllers will fall back to XB glyphs.

- Added new [b][i]Tutorial![/i][/b]

- Added new [b][i]Fire Lighting[/i][/b] mechanics.
Lighting Fires is now done by alternating the use item and drag item buttons repeatedly. A progress bar displaying the friction indicates the success rate of lighting a fire. Fire lighting animations, audio, particles, and lighting have all been updated as well.

- Added new [b][i]Hog[/i][/b] animal!
Unlike the small island boars these Giant Boars will protect the pact and hunt you down. They are very aggressive but provide a nice amount of leather and large meat.
Note: Requires an unvisited island or a new world to generate.

- Added new [b][i]Giant Crab[/i][/b] animal!
Giant Crabs have a very hard shell which will break spears and arrows. Aiming for their eyes is the only soft spot. Giant Crabs can also take damage from melee tools. These grumpy crabs think they own the island - Show them whose boss!
Note: Requires an unvisited island or a new world to generate.

- Added new [b][i]Reef Shark[/i][/b] model.

- Added new [b][i]Land Animal Spawners[/i][/b].
Crabs, Snakes, Boars, and Hogs will now respawn after a number of set days.
Note: Requires an unvisited island or a new world to generate.

- Added [b][i]Land Animal Spawners[/i][/b] to Map Editor.

- Added new [b][i]Provenance[/i][/b]/source for meats.

- Added [b][i]Raft Jumping Velocity[/i][/b] when standing on rafts. You will no longer fall off your raft when jumping.

- Added new [b][i]Blood Damage Particles[/i][/b] when damaging animals.
- Added new [b][i]Wood Damage Particles[/i][/b] when harvesting resources.
- Added new [b][i]Metal Damage Particles[/i][/b] when damaging metal objects.
- Added new [b][i]Leaf Damage Particles[/i][/b] when harvesting plants.
- Added new [b][i]Coconut Particles[/i][/b] when splitting.
- Added new [b][i]Boat Motor Particles[/i][/b] the water wake and engine steam.
- Added new [b][i]Water Still Particles[/i][/b] when the still is collecting water.
- Added new [b][i]Fuel Still Particles[/i][/b] when the still is collecting fuel.
- Added new [b][i]Smoker Particles[/i][/b] when food is being smoked.

[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1] 
- P2 can open but can’t navigate main menu.
- P2 can’t navigate dialogue buttons when P1 has controller connected.

[h1][b]Dev Notes[/b][/h1] 
- Majorly optimized object finding speed when loading.
- Added pretty JSON formatting. 
- Remove trailing commas on last JSON elements.

notes.title: 0.60.01 STABLE HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new hotfix 0.60.01 is up with some important fixes.[/b][/I][/h1]

Stay Alive!
:: Beam Team
–

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed a huge bug where number data was being serialized based on the user’s system language. Some locales use commas for decimal points which was breaking map loading and other things.
- Fixed empty [b]Crafting[/b] menu for non-English language users.
- Fixed regression. Fixed being able to craft combinations higher than current [b]Craftsmanship[/b] level.

notes.title: 0.43.00 EXP. UPDATE! NEW ANIMAL TRAPS, OCEAN CURRENT AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/8015ff00b3af32280041fd53833e9e32ea4ffda5.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.43.00 is up![/b][/I][/h1]

This update features new [b]Traps[/b], including a new [b]Fish Trap[/b] and [b]Bird Snare![/b] 

The [b]Fish Trap[/b] is back! The new Fish Trap does not require bait but does require assembling once placed in the water. Dismantle the Fish Trap and drag it to a new location to catch different species of fish. It is a slower alternative to Rod and Spear fishing so can take a few hours to catch something.
The [b]Bird Snare[/b] allows you to catch seagulls whilst you’re doing other activities. The snare triggers when a seagull lands on it and can then be collected and skinned.
The [b]Water Still[/b] has been adjusted to a more realistic design. You will now have to place foliage such as Palm Fronds and Fibrous Leaves into the bottom compartment while the top section will collect the evaporated droplets. This setup works similar to the Fuel Still Boiler.
There’s also a new [b]Ocean Current[/b] feature where all buoyant objects are affected by and move with the current. Rafts will automatically move at the ocean current speed which is approximately 1 knot. Sails will move rafts at the wind speed if raised, approximately 4-5 knots. It is possible to lose floating objects if you let them sail off into the horizon. This is where the recent addition of the Sea Anchor may come in handy!

That’s it for this update.
Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

notes.title: 0.42 EXP. UPDATE! NEW FUEL STILL, FISH FLOCKS, HIGH QUALITY SFX AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/c4edffa59fa08ae55e1eee423e5abbd3f7d192d9.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.42.00 has been released![/b][/I][/h1]

The new 0.42.00 update adds new [b]Fish Flocks[/b], [b]Fuel Still[/b], [b]Fueling System[/b] and new high-quality [b]Sound Effects![/b]

The new [b]Fuel Still[/b] uses [b]Potatoes[/b] to distil a crude ethanol fuel which can be used to power Vehicles. If you use combustion propulsion for your Rafts or Gyro you will probably want to start growing Potato crops ready to be distilled to ensure you have enough fuel for travelling. This functionality goes hand-in-hand with the re-introduction of the new [b]Fueling System[/b]. Like the good old days of Stranded Deep you will need to find and use Jerry cans to carry fuel and refill vehicles again. 

	This build also features new [b]Fish Flocks![/b]. The new flocks are part of our on-going work on the new fish system. The new flocks of small detail fish that can be found around shore-lines and reefs which help to add more life to the underwater environment in SD. 

Thanks to Paul and Felix, our friends at Only Sound, we are completely overhauling the sound effects in Stranded Deep. See below for a complete list of implemented audio effects and be sure to let us know what you think. Please note that some sounds are missing and some are WIP.
There’s been some adjustments to the Gyrocopter as we begin finalizing our end-game plans. The [b]Gyrocopter[/b] has been removed from the Story crafting tab and added as a craftable object in the renamed ‘Vehicles’ crafting category. You can obtain Gyrocopter parts from loot containers or mission rewards.

We’ve made some changes to the [b]Oxygen[/b] and [b]Drowning[/b] system. Now once a player is starved of oxygen the screen will fade black until death. The system no longer harshly relies on the player’s health.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

- Fixed bug in [b]Fish[/b] AI that was severely reducing effectiveness of avoidance in tight spaces.
- Fixed bug where [b]Fish[/b] environment bounds weight was overriding avoidance.

- Added new [b]Drowning[/b] player effect.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.41.01! NEW FISHING ROD, CONTROLLER SUPPORT, MED. BUFFS AND HEAPS MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/dad6171d86b8801fab8c1daa3200049204bce9c5.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.41.01 is up![/b][/I][/h1]

The new 0.41.01 update has been up on the stable branch for a few days now. It transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, we've recently added a new [b]Fishing Rod[/b] and [b]Bobber[/b], a completely new [b]Fish System[/b], [b]Official Controller Support[/b], the ability to craft new [b]Medicinal Buffs[/b], new [b]Farmable Plants[/b], a revamped [b]Life Raft[/b], new [b]Sailing[/b] mechanics, new [b]Diarrhoea[/b] effect and more!

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here ---
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/1654380436170281927]0.40 EXP. UPDATE! NEW FISHING ROD, LIFE RAFT[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/1468600276418305762]0.39 EXP. UPDATE! OFFICIAL CONTROLLER SUPPORT, CRAFTABLE MEDICINAL BUFFS[/url]

A short recap ---
[quote]Dual-analogue style controllers are now officially supported in this update. You can view the controller mapping in the Input settings menu.[/quote]
[quote]This update features the new [b]Fishing Rod[/b] and [b]Fish System[/b]! You can now craft a Fishing Rod and use it to catch fish! Fishing is a completely new game mechanic where you cast your line towards a group of fish, wait for a bite and then begin the struggle to reel it in! The Fishing Rod requires the new [b]Bobber[/b] item to be used, similar to the how the Bow uses Arrows.[/quote]
[quote]Sails have been split into separate Sail and Rudder components. A Sail adds forward propulsion, while a Rudder controls the direction. A raft will now begin moving whenever a sail is raised.[/quote]
[quote]Eating too much of the same food within a small window can now cause [b]Diarrhoea[/b]. Eating and drinking Coconuts and eating Potatoes are the only foods that cause Diarrhoea for now.
You will need to discover how much you can eat over a period of time. Once enough time has passed since you last ate that kind of food, you can go back to eating it again.[/quote]
[quote]Drinkable Coconuts have been replaced with a new [b]Coconut Flask[/b]. These flasks can be used as an ingredient together with native plants to craft [b]Medicinal Buffs[/b].[/quote]
[quote]The player now sits more forward on the Raft and controls it as you would in real life. Your forward controls move the raft forward as usual, however to change direction you need to rotate your raft by paddling left and right.[/quote]
[quote]Sun exposure is kept track of in-game, which is shown visually as sunburn on your arm. If you are exposed for longer than the time it takes to burn you’ll get Sunstroke. When you’ve contracted Sunstroke you need to find shade to reduce your sun exposure. You can keep track of your sun exposure by checking for visual signs of sunburn on your arm. [b]Aloe[/b] plants can be used to immediately reduce your sun exposure. This can be a simple way to prevent Sunstroke if you pay attention to the sunburn arm effect and re-apply every so often so it doesn’t escalate into Sunstroke. The other option is to be pro-active and craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] which will completely prevent any sun exposure and Sunstroke for 12 hours. [b]Sleeping[/b] in a Shelter is a quick way to remove Sunstroke if you’re unable to craft a salve.[/quote]

Have fun :)

Stay Alive!
:: Beam Team
--

[h1] [b]0.40.01-0.41.00 EXP. LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed new [b]Fish[/b] generating waypoints in unrealistic positions (under terrain, inside objects, etc) and the resulting glitches from attempting to move to that position.
- Changed [b]Fish[/b] bounds weight to apply exponentially to allow a bigger range of movement inside area bounds.
- Fixed [b]FPS Counter[/b] displaying in top corner of standalone builds.
- Fixed unsupported multiple [b]Sails[/b] causing weird physics bugs until new sailing mechanic completed.
- Fixed [b]Gyrocopter[/b] not ejecting player when underwater.
- Fixed not being able to interact with [b]Doors[/b].

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1] 
- Added auto-centering for [b]Raft Rudders[/b].

[h1] [b]0.38.00-0.41.00 STABLE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Mission Maps[/b] not being added to a new world when selecting New Game->Random.
- Fixed [b]Driftwood Half Wall[/b] crafting ingredients.
- Fixed [b]Snake[/b] AI behaviour errors when close to a player.
- Fixed [b]Snake[/b] rattle audio spamming.
- Fixed [b]Watch[/b] not refreshing player effects list.
- Fixed [b]Fire Torch[/b] burning underwater.
- Fixed [b]Player Speech[/b] playing when underwater.
- Fixed [b]Palm Tree[/b] not cutting when climb UI is displayed.
- Fixed [b]Palm Tree[/b] stumps stopping placing building constructions.
- Fixed [b[Small Plants[/b] stopping placing building constructions.
- Fixed [b]Skinnables[/b] not casting shadows.
- Fixed [b]Labelmaker[/b] input field being limited to 8 characters. 
- Fixed [b]Labelmaker[/b] not refreshing Hud UI immediately after renaming.
- Fixed [b]Player[/b] being able to continue eating when about to Vomit or Poop.
- Fixed scenario where [b]Vomiting[/b] would stack, breaking movement controls.
- Fixed [b]Item Info UI[/b] appearing incorrectly after saving options.
- Fixed [b]Tooltips[/b] being left behind onscreen when Crafting menu closed.
- Fixed [b]Containers[/b] staying ‘open’ if opened and then switched to Inventory storage.
- Fixed [b]Inventory[/b] opening after closing [b]Storage[/b] when ‘Toggle Radial Menus’ setting is enabled.
- Fixed [b]Underwater Audio[/b] continuing after death.
- Fixed [b]Boat Motor[/b] not moving backward.
- Fixed Player not crouching when using [b]Boat Motor[/b].
- Fixed [b]Gyrocopter[/b] compass showing wrong heading.
- Fixed [b]Gyrocopter[/b] not turning off.
- Fixed [b]Camera[/b] snapping when interacting with vehicles.
- Fixed medical [b]Breath Boost[/b] unable to be consumed.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1] 
- Added new [b]Input Remapping UI[/b].
- Added new [b]Consumables[/b] crafting category.
- Added unique [b]Action Descriptions[/b] when interacting with items, i.e. Hold to Refill, Open, Operate, Attach, etc.
- Added [b]Switch Item[/b] key.
- Added [b]Sprint Toggle[/b] functionality and input option setting.
- Added [b]Crafting Subcategory Icons[/b].
- Added [b]Radial UI[/b] display for incomplete constructables.
- Added [b]Watch Effect indicators[/b] for positive and negative effects. 
- Added [b]Sunblock Arm Effect[/b].
- Added support for multiple players to control and ride on [b]Vehicles[/b]. 
- Changed [b]Coconut[/b] to give you [b]Diarrhoea[/b] when too many are consumed.
- Changed [b]Coconut Food[/b] to give you [b]Diarrhoea[/b] when too many are consumed.
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] to give you [b]Diarrhoea[/b] unless cooked.
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] to be farmable.
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] calories from 100 to 200.
- Changed [b]Palm Top[/b] to give you 5 [b]Palm Fronds[/b] instead of 4.
- Changed [b]Sailing[/b] mechanic to require a [b]Sail[/b] and [b]Rudder[/b].
- Changed [b]Spear Animations[/b].
- Changed [b]Climb UI[/b] to display the actual key binding instead of ‘Jump.’
- Changed [b]Stick Farming Plot[/b] model.
- Changed [b]Sunblock[/b] duration to 12 hours.
- Changed [b]Sunburn[/b] duration to 7 hours.
- Changed [b]Sunburn[/b] Calorie and Hydration deduction from 350 to 200 per game hour.
- Changed [b]Hunger[/b] depletion time from 3 to 2 game days.
- Changed [b]Health Regeneration[/b] effect time to regenerate full health from 29 game hours to 7.
- Changed [b]Health Regeneration[/b] effect to activate only when Hunger and Thirst are above 6 bars and no negative effects.
- Changed calorie and thirst reduction while [b]Sleeping[/b] to be based on semi-realistic ratios.
- Changed [b]Snake[/b] to now [b]Poison[/b] player.
- Changed [b]Boar[/b] spawn chance from 10 to 20%.
- Changed [b]Logs[/b] Health from 150 to 100 units.
- Changed [b]Stone Tool[/b] crafting combination to only require 1x Rock.
- Changed [b]Stone Tool[/b] from ‘Invincible’ to have Durability.
- Changed [b]Stone Tool[/b] damage from 3 to 5 units.
- Changed [b]Fire Torch[/b] fuel from 6 hours to 12.
- Changed [b]Bed[/b] model to be on a wooden frame when placed.
- Changed [b]Smoker[/b] to be interactable like the Fire Spit and Hooks. You can now attach 5 items.
- Changed [b]Smoker[/b] to cook smokables while smoking.
- Updated [b]Smoker[/b] model.
- Updated [b]Potato[/b] item model.
- Updated [b]Steel Raft Floor[/b] deprecated model to new Clay building tier.
- Improved object layout when splitting [b]Splittable[/b] objects.
- Improved [b]Watch[/b] positioning in relation to the camera which adjusts with field of view.
- Adjusted [b]Boat Motor[/b] and [b]Gyrocopter[/b] engine volume.
- Renamed [b]Coconut Half[/b] to ‘Coconut Food’.
- Renamed [b]Coconut[/b] to ‘Coconut Drink’.
- Restored [b]Paddle[/b] as a physical item.

 [h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- Added official [b]Controller Support![/b]
Please note that the Cartographer has limited functionality with a controller and the Map Editor is not supported.

- Added new [b]Input System[/b]. 
There have been some big changes to the input system which is now much more efficient than the old system. It’s fairly boring to talk about but a big deal; supporting multiple controllers is another step towards supporting multiple players in the scene. The changes to the input system potentially affects a lot of other systems so we appreciate your bug reports as always.

- Added new [b]Fishing Rod[/b] and [b]Fishing Rod Bobber[/b] craftable items!

- Added new [b]Fishing Mechanic![/b]

- Added new [b]Fish[/b] system!
Better quality, more efficient fish animation.

- Added new [b]Diarrhoea[/b] status effect!

- Added new [b]Life Raft[/b] model.

- Added new [b]Sea Anchor[/b] to [b]Life Raft![/b]
Damps ocean movement. Will come into full effect with the addition of ocean currents.

- Added new [b]Storage[/b] to the [b]Life Raft![/b]

- Added new attachment to the [b]Life Raft[/b] to stow a [b]Paddle[/b].

- Added more realistic [b]Raft Paddling[/b].
The player now sits more forward on the Raft and controls it as you would in real life. You also require a paddle to be able to move the raft. Your forward controls move the raft forward as usual, however to change direction you need to rotate your raft by paddling left and right.

- Added new Raft [b]Rudder[/b] craftable item!

- Added new [b]Sail[/b] model.

- Added new [b]Food Ration Tin[/b] food item.
- Added [b]Coconut Flask[/b] water bottle!
- Added [b]Antidote[/b] consumable. Stops [b]Poison[/b]. 
- Added [b]Gauze[/b] consumable. Stop [b]Bleeding[/b].
- Added [b]Aloevera[/b] consumable. Stops [b]Sunstroke[/b].
- Added [b]Breath Booster[/b] consumable. Boosts underwater [b]Breath[/b] by 50% for 3 hours.
- Added [b]Shark Repellent[/b] consumable. Repels [b]Sharks[/b] for 12 hours.
- Added [b]Ajuga[/b] farming plant!
- Added [b]Pipi[/b] farming plant!
- Added [b]Wavulavula[/b] farming plant!
- Added new [b]Coconut[/b] model.
- Added new [b]Coconut Brown[/b] model.
- Added new [b]Coconut Half[/b] model.

[h1][b]MAP EDITOR[/b][/h1]
- Added [b]Coconuts[/b] to Map Editor.
- Added [b]Coconut Flasks[/b] to Map Editor.
- Added [b]Aloevera[/b] plant to Map Editor. 
- Added [b]Pipi [/b] plant to Map Editor.
- Added [b]Wavulavula [/b] plant to Map Editor.

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Added much better quality [b]Dither[/b] fading.
- Optimised [b]Splittable[/b] objects.
- Optimised input and physics for [b]Vehicles[/b] that aren’t being operated.
- Optimised [b]Intro[/b] Private Jet scene resources and asset loading.
- Updated [b]Intro[/b] Private Jet interior models and textures.

notes.title: 0.40 EXP. UPDATE! NEW FISHING ROD, LIFE RAFT AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/7a05c043bc4656bf212ec52a99478c57025cdd69.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.40.01 is up![/b][/I][/h1]

The new 0.40.01 update has been up on the experimental branch for a few days now. It adds a new [b]Fishing Rod[/b] and [b]Bobber[/b], a completely new [b]Fish System[/b], a revamped [b]Life Raft[/b], restored [b]Paddle[/b] and more!

This update features the new [b]Fishing Rod[/b] and [b]Fish System[/b]! You can now craft a Fishing Rod and use it to catch fish! Fishing is a completely new game mechanic where you cast your line towards a group of fish, wait for a bite and then begin the struggle to reel it in! The Fishing Rod requires the new [b]Bobber[/b] item to be used, similar to the how the Bow uses Arrows.

The Fish system has also been completely overhauled and is more efficient. There is only one fish in this update for basic testing of the new fishing mechanics. The fish have very basic AI so expect some unusual behaviour. The revamped fish system has been created to support large fish flocks which will be coming next update. Spear fishing is not supported in this build.

We’ve majorly pimped your ride for this update. We heard you like paddles, so we’ve restored the [b]Paddle[/b] as a physical item and it also has a new dedicated attachment on the Life Raft to stow it away so you don’t lose it. We’ve added a new [b]Storage[/b] container to the Life Raft which is filled with basic supplies when starting a new game. This will make it easier for us to balance the game, while not making it too difficult in the beginning. There’s also a new [b]Sea Anchor[/b] item fitted to the Life Raft which you can deploy to prevent the raft moving position. 

Sails have been split into separate Sail and Rudder components. A Sail adds forward propulsion, while a Rudder controls the direction. A raft will now begin moving whenever a sail is raised. There is a new wind and ocean current system coming in the next update - just didn’t quite get it finished before the xmas/ny holidays. It features much more realistic sailing, including using the wind, tacking upwind, etc. The Sea Anchor will also come into full effect once the ocean currents are fully implemented. For now, we don’t recommend using multiple sails at once as it could result in some unusual glitches.

Eating too much of the same food within a small window can now cause [b]Diarrhoea[/b]. Eating and drinking Coconuts and eating Potatoes are the only foods that cause Diarrhoea for now.
You will need to discover how much you can eat over a period of time. Once enough time has passed since you last ate that kind of food, you can go back to eating it again. 
Diarrhoea and Vomiting instantly removes one bar of fluids from your vitals. If you get Diarrhoea, it will completely deplete your fluids within 1 game hour, at which point you’ll get the Dehydration status effect also. So it will be important to manage your fluids during that game hour if you get Diarrhoea!

In other development news, we’ve teamed up with the guys from OnlySound to produce more immersive and awesome sound effects which should start appearing in the game soon. We’ve also got some more exciting collaborations that we’ll update you on through the year!

[h1][i]Note: We fixed a few shenanigans from the previous input update. Please reset your input to defaults before reassigning new custom inputs as they could load back incorrect assignments.[/i][/h1]

[h1][i]Note: For those of you that the caught the early release of 0.40.00, we’ve removed the new brutal mode, where logs and palm fronds weren’t splitting ;)[/i][/h1]

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team

- Fixed [b]Input[/b] options menu being set to dirty when first selected.
- Fixed [b]Input[/b] error when assignment timeout.

- Fixed being unable to pickup [b]Pipi[/b] and [b]Potato[/b] farming plants.
- Fixed [b]Pipi[/b] plant display name when planted.
- Fixed floating [b]Farming Plants[/b].
- Fixed medical [b]Breath Boost[/b] unable to be consumed.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1] 
- Restored [b]Paddle[/b] as a physical item.
- Added support for multiple players to control and ride on [b]Vehicles[/b]. 
- Added unique [b]Action Descriptions[/b] when interacting with items, i.e. Hold to Refill, Open, Operate, Attach, etc.
- Improved object layout when splitting [b]Splittable[/b] objects.
- Renamed [b]Coconut Half[/b] to ‘Coconut Food’.
- Renamed [b]Coconut[/b] to ‘Coconut Drink’.
- Changed [b]Green Coconut[/b] to require hitting to ‘open’ again.
- Changed [b]Coconut[/b] to split into [b]Coconut Food[/b] when hit or thrown with force again.
- Changed [b]Coconut[/b] to give you [b]Diarrhoea[/b] when too many are consumed.
- Changed [b]Coconut Food[/b] to give you [b]Diarrhoea[/b] when too many are consumed.
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] to give you [b]Diarrhoea[/b] unless cooked.
- Changed [b]Palm Top[/b] to give you 5 [b]Palm Fronds[/b] instead of 4.
- Adjusted [b]Boat Motor[/b] and [b]Gyrocopter[/b] engine volume.
- Updated [b]Smoker[/b] model.
- Changed [b]Sailing[/b] mechanic to require a [b]Sail[/b] and [b]Rudder[/b].
- Changed [b]Spear Animations[/b].
- Changed [b]Stick Farming Plot[/b] model.

 [h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- Added new [b]Fishing Rod[/b] and [b]Fishing Rod Bobber[/b] craftable items!

- Added new [b]Fishing Mechanic![/b]

- Added new [b]Fish[/b] system!
Better quality, more efficient fish animation.

- Added new [b]Diarrhoea[/b] status effect!

- Added new [b]Life Raft[/b] model.

- Added new [b]Sea Anchor[/b] to [b]Life Raft![/b]
Damps ocean movement. Will come into full effect with the addition of ocean currents.

- Added new [b]Storage[/b] to the [b]Life Raft![/b]

- Added new attachment to the [b]Life Raft[/b] to stow a [b]Paddle[/b].

- Added more realistic [b]Raft Paddling[/b].
The player now sits more forward on the Raft and controls it as you would in real life. Your forward controls move the raft forward as usual, however to change direction you need to rotate your raft by paddling left and right.

- Added new Raft [b]Rudder[/b] craftable item!
- Added new [b]Sail[/b] model.

- Added new [b]Food Ration Tin[/b] food item.

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Added much better quality [b]Dither[/b] fading.
- Optimised [b]Splittable[/b] objects.
- Optimised input and physics for [b]Vehicles[/b] that aren’t being operated.

notes.title: 0.39 EXP. UPDATE! OFFICIAL CONTROLLER SUPPORT, CRAFTABLE MEDICINAL BUFFS AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/d6b85cbd2a17feb6cb4ef9957af3c7ef8373a1bc.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.39.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1]This build adds [b]Official Controller Support[/b], the ability to craft new [b]Medicinal Buffs[/b], new [b]Farmable Plants[/b] and more![/h1]

	Dual-analogue style [b]Controllers[/b] are now officially supported in this update. You can view the controller mapping in the Input settings menu. See the patch notes for more info and the changes to the input system.
 
You can craft a new item - the [b]Coconut Flask[/b]. These flasks can be used as an ingredient together with native plants to craft [b]Medicinal Buffs[/b], which you will find in the new [b]Consumables[/b] crafting category. There are 5 new medicinal buffs: [b]Antidote[/b], which cures poisoning; [b]Gauze[/b], which stops bleeding; [b]Aloe Salve[/b], which prevents sunstroke; [b]Breath Boost[/b], which increases your breath by 50% for 3 hours; and [b]Shark Repellent[/b], which repels Sharks for 12 hours. The medicinal buffs use three new plants: [b]Pipi[/b], [b]Wavulvula[/b] and [b]Ajuga[/b]. These are small native plants that can be found growing in the ground cover around the islands. All of the recently added plants are farmable as well so you can collect and grow these new plants to make your medicines. 

The Sunburn status effect has had some more tweaks in our efforts to really dial in the new environmental effects. The Sunburn status effect has been renamed to [b]Sunstroke[/b] as it makes more sense. To recap - your sun exposure is kept track of in-game which is shown visually as sunburn on your arm. The time it takes for you to burn is based on the UV index, the same as before. If you are exposed for longer than the time it takes to burn you’ll get Sunstroke. When you’ve contracted Sunstroke you need to find shade to reduce your sun exposure. You can keep track of your sun exposure by checking for visual signs of sunburn on your arm. [b]Aloe[/b] plants can be used to immediately reduce your sun exposure. This can be a simple way to prevent Sunstroke if you pay attention to the sunburn arm effect and re-apply every so often so it doesn’t escalate into Sunstroke. The other option is to be pro-active and craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] which will completely prevent any sun exposure and Sunstroke for 12 hours. [b]Sleeping[/b] in a Shelter is a quick way to remove Sunstroke if you’re unable to craft a salve.

[h1][b]TL/DR:[/b]
- If you get [b]Sunstroke[/b] you need to reduce your sun exposure by finding shade or using one of the items below, otherwise you will stay sun stricken. 
- [b]Aloe[/b] resets your sun exposure. This can essentially prevent Sunstroke if you pay attention to your sunburn arm effect and re-apply Aloe every ‘x’ hours (‘x’ is based on the UV intensity).
- [b]Aloe Salves[/b] completely prevent sun exposure and Sunstroke for 12 hours.[/h1]

There’s also been heaps of tweaks, so be sure to see the patch notes to catch them all.
Have fun :)

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Mission Maps[/b] not being added to a new world when selecting New Game->Random.
- Fixed [b]Item Info UI[/b] appearing incorrectly after saving options.
- Fixed [b]Driftwood Half Wall[/b] crafting ingredients.
- Fixed [b]Snake[/b] AI behaviour errors when close to a player.
- Fixed [b]Snake[/b] rattle audio spamming.
- Fixed [b]Watch[/b] not refreshing player effects list.
- Fixed [b]Fire Torch[/b] burning underwater.
- Fixed [b]Detail Foliage[/b] not generating when starting a game.
- Fixed [b]Player Speech[/b] playing when underwater.
- Fixed [b]Palm Tree[/b] not cutting when climb UI is displayed.
- Fixed [b]Palm Tree[/b] stumps stopping placing building constructions.
- Fixed [b[Small Plants[/b] stopping placing building constructions.
- Fixed [b]Skinnables[/b] not casting shadows.
- Fixed [b]Labelmaker[/b] input field being limited to 8 characters. 
- Fixed [b]Labelmaker[/b] not refreshing Hud UI immediately after renaming.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added new [b]Consumables[/b] crafting category.
- Added new [b]Input Remapping UI[/b].
- Added [b]Switch Item[/b] key.
- Added [b]Sprint Toggle[/b] functionality and input option setting.
- Added [b]Crafting Subcategory Icons[/b].
- Added [b]Radial UI[/b] display for incomplete constructables.
- Added [b]Watch Effect indicators[/b] for positive and negative effects. 
- Added [b]Sunblock Arm Effect[/b].
- Changed [b]Sunblock[/b] duration to 12 hours.
- Changed [b]Sunburn[/b] duration to 7 hours.
- Changed [b]Sunburn[/b] Calorie and Hydration deduction from 350 to 200 per game hour.
- Changed [b]Hunger[/b] depletion time from 3 to 2 game days.
- Changed [b]Health Regeneration[/b] effect time to regenerate full health from 29 game hours to 7.
- Changed [b]Health Regeneration[/b] effect to activate only when Hunger and Thirst are above 6 bars and no negative effects.
- Changed calorie and thirst reduction while [b]Sleeping[/b] to be based on semi-realistic ratios.
- Changed [b]Snake[/b] to now [b]Poison[/b] player.
- Changed [b]Boar[/b] spawn chance from 10 to 20%.
- Changed [b]Coconuts[/b] to be consumed on use.	
- Changed [b]Coconuts[/b] to only provide [b]Hydration[/b].
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] to be farmable.
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] to no longer require Cooking.
- Changed [b]Potato[/b] Calories from 100 to 200.
- Changed [b]Logs[/b] Health from 150 to 100 units.
- Changed [b]Stone Tool[/b] crafting combination to only require 1x Rock.
- Changed [b]Stone Tool[/b] from ‘Invincible’ to have Durability.
- Changed [b]Stone Tool[/b] damage from 3 to 5 units.
- Changed [b]Fire Torch[/b] fuel from 6 hours to 12.
- Changed [b]Bed[/b] model to be on a wooden frame when placed.
- Changed [b]Smoker[/b] to be interactable like the Fire Spit and Hooks. You can now attach 5 items.
- Changed [b]Smoker[/b] to cook smokables while smoking.
- Changed [b]Climb UI[/b] to display the actual key binding instead of ‘Jump.’
- Improved [b]Watch[/b] positioning in relation to the camera which adjusts with field of view.
- Updated [b]Potato[/b] item model.
- Updated [b]Steel Raft Floor[/b] deprecated model to new Clay building tier.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- Added official [b]Controller Support![/b]
Please note that the Cartographer has limited functionality with a controller and the Map Editor is not supported.

- Added new [b]Input System[/b]. 
There have been some big changes to the input system which is now much more efficient than the old system. It’s fairly boring to talk about but a big deal; supporting multiple controllers is another step towards supporting multiple players in the scene. The changes to the input system potentially affects a lot of other systems so we appreciate your bug reports as always.

- Added [b]Gauze[/b] consumable. Stop [b]Bleeding[/b].
- Added [b]Aloevera[/b] consumable. Stops [b]Sunstroke[/b].

- Added [b]Shark Repellent[/b] consumable. Repels [b]Sharks[/b] for 12 hours.
- Added [b]Ajuga[/b] farming plant!

These flasks can be used as an ingredient together with native plants to craft [b]Medicinal Buffs[/b], which you will find in the new [b]Consumables[/b] crafting category. There are 5 new medicinal buffs: [b]Antidote[/b], which cures poisoning; [b]Gauze[/b], which stops bleeding; [b]Aloe Salve[/b], which prevents sunstroke; [b]Breath Boost[/b], which increases your breath by 50% for 3 hours; and [b]Shark Repellent[/b], which repels Sharks for 12 hours. The medicinal buffs use three new plants: [b]Pipi[/b], [b]Wavulvula[/b] and [b]Ajuga[/b]. These are small native plants that can be found growing in the ground cover around the islands. All of the recently added plants are farmable as well so you can collect and grow these new plants to make your medicines. 

The Sunburn status effect has had some more tweaks in our efforts to really dial in the new environmental effects. The Sunburn status effect has been renamed to [b]Sunstroke[/b] as it makes more sense. To recap - your sun exposure is kept track of in-game which is shown visually as sunburn on your arm. The time it takes for you to burn is based on the UV index, the same as before. If you are exposed for longer than the time it takes to burn you’ll get Sunstroke. When you’ve contracted Sunstroke you need to find shade to reduce your sun exposure. You can keep track of your sun exposure by checking for visual signs of sunburn on your arm. [b]Aloe[/b] plants can be used to immediately reduce your sun exposure. This can be a simple way to prevent Sunstroke if you pay attention to the sunburn arm effect and re-apply every so often so it doesn’t escalate into Sunstroke. The other option is to be pro-active and craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] which will completely prevent any sun exposure and Sunstroke for 12 hours. [b]Sleeping[/b] in a Shelter is a quick way to remove Sunstroke if you’re unable to craft a salve.

[h1][b]TL/DR:[/b]
- If you get [b]Sunstroke[/b] you need to reduce your sun exposure by finding shade or using one of the items below, otherwise you will stay sun stricken. 
- [b]Aloe[/b] resets your sun exposure. This can essentially prevent Sunstroke if you pay attention to your sunburn arm effect and re-apply Aloe every ‘x’ hours (‘x’ is based on the UV intensity).
- [b]Aloe Salves[/b] completely prevent sun exposure and Sunstroke for 12 hours.[/h1]

There’s also been heaps of tweaks, so be sure to see the patch notes to catch them all.
Have fun :)

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team

notes.title: UPDATE 0.38! GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/cd51d5547c11fb4253807b80989288bf40f261a1.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.38.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, we've recently replaced the previous environmental effects with a better [b]UV system[/b] and introduced a new craftable [b]Gyrocopter[/b] as part of the end-game scenario!

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1462966762731355827]0.37.02 NEW GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM, ALOE AND MORE![/url]

A short recap ---

[quote]This update adds more to our end-game scenario. It has always been our plan for the player to be rescued by helicopter after completing a series of objectives, but recently we thought ‘Why don’t we let the player build their [i]own[/i] helicopter?’ ...and so in this build you can now build your very own [b]Gyrocopter[/b] in true MacGyver style! You will need to collect all the parts to build the Gyrocopter which you can do by completing the new missions. The Gyrocopter will eventually form part of the final end-game story/event.

This update also addresses the controversial new environmental status effects. After seeing how they were playing out and listening to player feedback we realise we took a few missteps. The most obvious is that players weren’t able to manage the effects other than limiting exposure, which meant hiding under a tree or sitting next to a fire for x hours – not fun. The flu was just annoying so we’ve removed it and focused on making the sun a better and more manageable threat.[/quote]

Please see the patch notes linked above for more info on the new UV system, but TL/DR:
- The risk of sunburn time is 10am-3pm.
- The higher the UV index, the quicker you burn.
- Find [b]Aloe[/b] to cure Sunburn.
- Craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] to prevent Sunburn.

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
-- 

[h1][b]0.36.00-0.38.00 STABLE CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added [b]Sunburn[/b] status effect.
- Removed [b]Heatstroke[/b] status effect.
- Removed [b]Flu[/b] status effect.
- Added [b]Vertical Swimming[/b] movement with [Jump] and [Crouch] controls.
- Removed [b]Shark[/b] respawning.
- Removed [b]Firetorch[/b] and [b]Refined Axe[/b]  from loot.
- Removed [Jump] button cancelling vehicle operation.
- Increased [b]Underwater Breath[/b] by 15 seconds.
- Increased [b]Water Still[/b] refill time from 0.2 hours to 1.0 hours.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Atmospheric[/b] and [b]Underwater Fog[/b] drawing over transparent effects - crafting ghost, smoke, etc.
- Fixed display name repeating for empty [b]Fire Torches[/b].
- Fixed different sound effects for [b]Drinking[/b] and [b]Eating.[/b]
- Fixed [b]Quick Crafting[/b] and [b]Crafting[/b] menu not refreshing Hud UI on close.
- Fixed Player [b]Status Effects[/b] not saving correct display names.
- Fixed teleporting to operating position when first operating [b]Rafts.[/b]
- Fixed being able to place [b]Bed Shelter[/b] in mid air.
- Fixed being able to place [b]Farming Plot[/b] in mid air.
- Fixed terrain generating sharp edges on [b]Shorelines[/b].
- Fixed player [b]Super Jump[/b] when jumping near shorelines.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- Added new [b]Aloe Plant[/b] to cure [b]Sunburn[/b].
- Added new [b]Aloe Salve[/b] to prevent [b]Sunburn[/b].
- Added new [b]UV Index[/b] display on Watch.
- Added new [b]Heatwave[/b] display on Watch.
- Added new [b]Gyrocopter[/b] craftable vehicle!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Frame[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Seat[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Motor[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Cockpit[/b] mission reward!
- Added [b]Gyrocopter Rotors[/b] mission reward!

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Changed [b]Player[/b] code structure to support multiple players in a scene in the future.
- Changed [b]Watch[/b] to load from external bundle to support custom watches in the future.
- Optimized [b]Buoyancy[/b] by calculating wave positions for all buoyant objects in a single batch.

notes.title: 0.37 EXP. UPDATE! NEW GYROCOPTER STORY GOAL, UV SYSTEM, ALOE AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/0aba409f27a624f447f087eb3865fe8c5a735164.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new experimental build 0.37.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

This update adds more to our end-game scenario. It has always been our plan for the player to be rescued by helicopter after completing a series of objectives, but recently we thought ‘Why don’t we let the player build their [i]own[/i] helicopter?’ ...and so in this build you can now build your very own [b]Gyrocopter[/b] in true MacGyver style!
    
You will need to collect all the parts to build the Gyrocopter which you can do by completing the new missions. There’s a few Gyro parts unlocked for the time being while we finish off the rest of the missions. The Gyrocopter will eventually form part of the final end-game story/event.

This update also addresses the controversial new environmental status effects. After seeing how they were playing out and listening to player feedback we realise we took a few missteps. The most obvious is that players weren’t able to manage the effects other than limiting exposure, which meant hiding under a tree or sitting next to a fire for x hours – not fun. The flu was just annoying so we’ve removed it and focused on making the sun a better and more manageable threat. 
    
The effect of the sun on the player now correlates to a ‘UV Index’ shown on your watch. The UV Index is an indicator of harmful solar UV radiation. It ranges from Low, Medium, High, Very High and Extreme. It is affected by the time of year with the months from June-September being the most deadly. This will be tied into a game setting in the future, but just keep that in mind if you’re finding the sun too intense. There are also heatwaves which increase temperatures and the UV index. When there is a heatwave the temperature icon is replaced with a heatwave icon on the watch display. The UV index affects how quickly you burn from the sun:

    11+ Extreme – 1 hour
    8-10 Very High – 2 hours
    6-7 High – 4 hours
    3-5 Moderate – 5 hours
    1-2 Low – Effectively never.

If you are exposed for the corresponding amount of time you will get [b]Sunburn[/b] effect. This effect drains your thirst and hunger until it has worn off. The new method to remove Sunburn is to use the new plant, [b]Aloe[/b]. You can find Aloe dotted around islands like other plants and it allows you to cure a Sunburn immediately. Aloe is also farmable. As you progress you will also be able to craft an [b]Aloe Salve[/b] to cure and prevent Sunburn from happening. Aloe Salves will be incorporated with a new station and arm effects in a coming update. As before, you can also find shade for x game hours to remove Sunburn.

Once you have Sunburn it will deplete your thirst and hunger completely within 2 game hours. This gives you plenty of time to find shade or Aloe. Keep in mind that even when your hunger and thirst are fully depleted it still takes approx. 3 game days to deplete your health (if you have no other status effects). So you have quite a lot of time to fix your problems!

The temperature shown on your watch now displays the ‘apparent temperature’ which is how hot it actually feels based on the humidity. This temperature currently doesn’t contribute to any status effects, but we may look at restoring Heatstroke based on the apparent temperature – However, sometimes realism doesn’t equal fun!

[h1][b]TL/DR:[/b]
- The higher the UV index, the quicker you burn.
- The risk of sunburn time is 10am-3pm.
- Find [b]Aloe[/b] to cure Sunburn.
- Craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] to prevent Sunburn.[/h1]

There’s also been some large changes to the backend to support some upcoming features so we appreciate letting us know of any new bugs you find.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

So you have quite a lot of time to fix your problems!

The temperature shown on your watch now displays the ‘apparent temperature’ which is how hot it actually feels based on the humidity. This temperature currently doesn’t contribute to any status effects, but we may look at restoring Heatstroke based on the apparent temperature – However, sometimes realism doesn’t equal fun!

[h1][b]TL/DR:[/b]
- The higher the UV index, the quicker you burn.
- The risk of sunburn time is 10am-3pm.
- Find [b]Aloe[/b] to cure Sunburn.
- Craft [b]Aloe Salves[/b] to prevent Sunburn.[/h1]

There’s also been some large changes to the backend to support some upcoming features so we appreciate letting us know of any new bugs you find.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team

notes.title: UPDATE 0.32! QUICK-CRAFTING, WEATHER, STATIONS AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/8bbeed41544de06fcde4012e92c02493d9a8e999.png[/img]

Hi everyone,	

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.32.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]
	
This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. 
If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, here’s some of the new features included: [h1][b]New Quick Crafting Menu, Weather Effects, Plank Station, Leather Waterskin, Damage Indicators and more![/b][/h1]

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1270425921141907027]0.31.00 Weather Update[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1270424470893521944]0.30.00 Quick Crafting Menu Update[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/313120/announcements/detail/1306451998879913777]0.29.00 Player Effects, Waterskin and Plank Station Update[/url]

[b]Please note[/b] – We’ve changed the shoreline generation going forward in this build. Previously generated islands have very bumpy underwater areas and the larger waves will create unpleasant visual artefacts on these areas! It is also possible that your previously saved islands will re-generate slightly different.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

 [h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Updated [b]Weather Events[/b] to save and load state correctly.
- Reduced required attempts to start a [b]Camp Fire[/b].
- Changed [b]Crafting[/b] to only use items in the area in front of you.
- Changed [b]Watch[/b] to display the player’s status effects on additional screen.
- Changed [b]Sail[/b] and [b]Motor[/b] placement to use rotating keys. 
- Increased [b]Clay Waterbottle[/b] servings from 4 to 5.
- Added new [b]Main Menu[/b] soundtrack.
- Added [b]Inventory[/b] functionality to display health, durability or servings.
- Changed [b]Walls, Arches, Doors[/b], etc to allow 180 degree rotation when placing.
- Updated [b]Icons[/b] in Crafting menus.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed not being able to pick up [b]Logs[/b] after saving.
- Fixed [b]Ocean[/b] colors changing incorrectly when weather event assigned but not active.
- Fixed [b]Mouse Sensitivity[/b] resetting when drawing weapon.
- Fixed [b]Clay Foundation[/b] collider interfering with Steps placement.
- Fixed being able to craft building combos without Hammer, Hoe, etc.
- Fixed not being able to place [b]Hooks[/b] and [b]Shelves[/b] from previous build.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
- New [b]Quick Crafting[/b] menu!
To open the new Quick Crafting menu press and hold the crafting menu key [C] for a short moment, similar to the interacting mechanic. The Quick Crafting menu won’t display if you don’t have any craftable combinations from the materials in front of you or in your backpack. If you press the crafting key [C] once without holding it, it will open the regular crafting menu.
Similar to the large crafting menu, the Quick Crafting menu uses any tools in your hands to enable and prioritize combinations shown. For eg: if you have a Hammer equipped, the Quick Crafting menu will display any available building combinations first. Likewise, if you have a Hoe equipped farming combinations will be displayed first and so on. 

- New [b]Storm Weather Effect[/b]!
With lightning and large ocean waves!

- New [b]Plank Station[/b]!
	To craft planks by riving logs.

- New [b]Leather Waterskin[/b] item!

- New [b]Player Effects![/b]
Sunburn, Heatstroke, Cold, Flu. These are long term effects, not meant to annoy, but definitely there. Adds feedback with sounds effects and animations…
This will be incorporated more fully with building tiers in a future update. Offer less protection from the elements.

- New [b]Game Over Screen[/b].

- New [b]Death animation.[/b]

- New [b]New Day Notifications![/b]

- New [b]Damage Indicators![/b]
	Subtle damage indicators to help visualize where the damage is coming from.  

- New [b]Container[/b] name stencils! 
When containers are renamed it is now shows their name as a themed stencil on the side of the container for easier object organization.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.28! NEW MINING, ROOFING, RESOURCES AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/6d5bd265280a08b49467b1f57117237a6c6a8595.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.28.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][I][b]IMPORTANT:  There are notes below covering the new save game location and instructions for copying over your previous save data. Please follow these instructions if you wish to preserve your old save game.[/b][/I][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch. 
If you haven’t been following the progress of our experimental branch, here’s some of the new features included: [h1][b]New Mining System, New Roofing System, New Clay and Rock minable resources and Pick tool, New Brick building tier, New Furnace and Brick stations and more![/b][/h1]

We’ve covered the new features in the patch notes below and you can also read more on the new features in our previous experimental patch notes here:
[URL=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/630906352211567915]New Clay resource, Brick building tier, Furnace and Brick station[/URL]
[URL= http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/630907614661156726]New Roofing system[/URL]
[URL= http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437092664/announcements/detail/616271552112502259]New Mining system and Minable resources[/URL]

We had been receiving emails about players not having user permissions to write world or map data. There were a few possible causes for the error, but the most common seemed to be when the game was installed in the Program Files folder and the user account didn’t have sufficient privileges or security settings. So from this stable build on we’ve changed the location of the game’s save data. You will need to do a simple copy-paste to move your old save folder to the new location. A quick guide can be found here ---
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=892983896
This also allows players with multiple users (brothers, sisters, friends, etc) to have their own unique save game data if they have their own user account on the PC.

Also a small note for Mac users: In testing we have noticed that the game needs to be launched from the Steam app or a desktop shortcut created by Steam. If the game is run directly from the .app file, Steam fails to register as initialised and you will see an error message in the game.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]0.24.01-0.28.00 CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Shipwrecks[/b] not spawning on Small Islands.
- Fixed item display names not persisting. 
- Fixed [b]Smoked Meat[/b] reverting when stored in Containers.
- Fixed [b]Water Still[/b] resetting timer when re-entering an island causing much longer waits.
- Fixed occupied or invalid building connectors blocking valid connectors behind when placing.

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added Hammer mechanics to [b]Tutorial.[/b]
- Added shadows to [b]Crafting Ghost[/b] for better sense of placement depth.
- Replaced [b]Steel[/b] building tier with new [b]Clay[/b] building tier.
- Replaced [b]Buckets[/b] with new [b]Clay Water Bottle[/b].
- Changed [b]Steps[/b] placement to use rotating keys.
- Changed crafted objects to immediately pickup or store in backpack when crafted if possible.
- Changed [b]Clay Waterbottle[/b] to start off empty.
- Changed world data and save file location to use user’s special documents folder.
- Increased [b]Solar Still[/b] collection rate.
- Moved [b]Wedge Foundations[/b] and [b]Wedge Floors[/b] into Foundations and Floors crafting categories.
- Removed [b]Structural Support[/b].

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Mining[/b] system!
There’s a new tool – the [b]Refined Pick[/b] and two new minable resources – [b]Rock[/b] and [b]Clay[/b]. You can use the Pick to harvest the new resources which can be found around the islands. Rock is generally found on the islands, while Clay can be found under the water around the islands.

- New [b]Pick[/b] craftable item!
- New [b]Rock[/b] resource!
- New [b]Clay[/b] resource!

- New [b]Building Tier – Clay Bricks![/b]
The Steel building tier did not fit the survival theme of Stranded Deep so it has been replaced with a [b]Clay Brick[/b] tier. [b]Clay[/b] can be found on islands and turned into Bricks with a Furnace and Brick station.

- New [b]Brick[/b] station!
- New [b]Clay Bricks[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Foundation[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Floor[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Wall[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Half Wall[/b] building item! 
- New [b]Brick Windowed Wall[/b] building item!
- New [b]Brick Arch[/b] building item!

- New [b]Roof[/b] building system!
The new Roof system is the final piece to constructing an authentic looking island hut! There’s two new types of roofing – Wood/Thatched and Clay/Brick. There’s 4 different roof pieces available so you can fill in most designs. Don’t forget that you can rotate building pieces with the Q and E keys when placing. These keys can also be reassigned in the input settings. It will be important to remember to use these keys so you can place roof pieces in the correct orientation with all the different placement possibilities.

- New [b]Wood Roof Middle[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Wood Roof Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Wood Roof Wedge Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Wood Roof Cap[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Middle[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Wedge Corner[/b] building piece!
- New [b]Clay Roof Cap[/b] building piece!

- New [b]Furnace[/b] station!
- New [b]Clay Water Bottle[/b] item!

- New [b]Great White Shark[/b] animal!

[h1][b]0.27.00-0.28.00 CHANGE LOG[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Skinning[/b] not allowing you to skin with a full inventory when the reward is Rawhide.
- Fixed [b]Skinnable[/b] animals not saving skinned state correctly. 
- Fixed possibility of [b]Tutorial[/b] crafting objectives not completing if auto-stored in backpack.

[h1][b]DEV NOTES[/b][/h1]
- Reduced performance overhead when creating and initializing new items.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.24! NEW STORAGE, BUILDING MECHANICS AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7571256/5a3858cacde90cdddccf494113484bdcbd50c8f6.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h1][I][b]A new stable build 0.24.00 has just been released![/b][/I][/h1]

[h1][b]This build features expanded Building mechanics and the new Storage system![/b][/h1]

This build transitions our latest work on the experimental branch to the stable branch – the new [b]Storage[/b] system. In case you missed our rundown of the new feature in the experimental patch notes, the mechanics are very simple and fast – if you’re looking at a container, press [Tab] to open it to display a similar radial style menu as the backpack inventory. The basic radial mechanics are the same as the inventory, except now you will see a small backpack at the bottom that you can click on to toggle between your backpack and the storage container and vice-versa. Clicking on items in either ‘container’ will transfer the item to the other container. Most containers will be able to be picked up, but containers cannot store other containers.

Every couple of months we pause to revaluate the project to make sure we’re on the right track, listen to feedback and address outstanding bugs. We’ve made some adjustments in this build based on player feedback. A few players have requested the option to choose between toggling the new radial menus open vs. the existing ‘rocker’ functionality so we’ve added an option for that in the input settings. We’ve improved the [b]Charging[/b] mechanic for projectile-based weapons so you can now stop charging a weapon without needing to wait for the charging animation to complete. It seems like a small tweak but all helps to add polish. The new Crafting menu now also keeps a bit more of a memory. Individual crafting category tabs will keep a memory of their last subcategory and scroll position until you change category. This should help speed up things like building in particular where you might use the same tab and combination multiple times. One of the bigger changes is that we’ve removed the polarizing [b]Discovery Fog[/b] feature which you can read more details on in the patch notes below. We’re also actively working on bringing back the old [b]Infinite Procedural Generation[/b]. Please bear with us while we work on integrating this system with the Cartographer. The Cartographer will still remain, providing a small starting world or ‘archipelago’ to start in. From there you can venture further out from the starting world and it will be infinite in any direction. We’re also working on an end game scenario which will require you to find rare items and put down roots on an island to piece together your recue.

We’ve noticed a lot of support emails coming in regarding missing subcategories in the new Crafting menu. 9.9/10 this is fixed by verifying the game files in Steam. It appears to be a problem with Steam’s version control between the updates as the problem is solved by verifying the files.

Have fun!

Stay Alive! 
:: Beam Team 
--

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
- Added reminder to craft a Shelter to [b]Save[/b] in pause menu.
- Added option for [b]Radial Menus[/b] to choose between toggle and rocker behaviour.
- Added ability to interrupt charging sequence for projectile weapons.
- Added edit and delete buttons to custom maps in the [b]Cartographer[/b].
- Added tooltip to view details of maps placed in the world when hovered over.
- Added [b]Building[/b] rotation with new key-bindings.
- Added [b]Billboard Density[/b] quality setting. 
- Changed Inventory to show slot quantity permanently.
- Changed Crafting menu to remember last subcategory and scroll position.
- Changed to not freeze movement when opening inventory.
- Increased Fibrous Leave’s inventory stack capacity.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
- Fixed [b]Dragging[/b] not using current clicked position making dragging more difficult than it should be.
- Fixed animal [b]Ragdoll[/b] bones only saving position not physics related data, ie: stop Sharks flying when loaded. This fix is not retroactive but will take effect after your next save.
- Fixed projectiles interfering with [b]Ragdoll[/b] physics when killed.
- Fixed floating [b]Containers[/b] when loading a Custom Map.

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

- New [b]Storage Menu![/b]

- New [b]Building Mechanic![/b]
Building has been expanded and broken down. Most building pieces now have 2 different stages of construction. Once the initial building piece has been placed you use your Hammer on the piece to finish off constructing it. This new mechanic will tie into player and weather effects in a future update. Incomplete walls and floors won’t protect you as well from the elements as completed pieces. Likewise, lower tiers will offer less protection from sun and rain than higher tiers. Weather effects will also deteriorate building pieces so you will have to repair your structures as they’re damaged. This provides a purpose and motivation to find better building materials that offer better protection and resistance to weather. The new system has been integrated with the Wood, Plank and Corrugated tiers. Driftwood and Steel are yet to be completed as we’re re-evaluating and finalizing the base and highest tiers. Existing building pieces also have additional LOD’s.

- New [b]Loot Containers![/b]
Added new Wood Crate, Small Locker, Large Locker and Console models. Added these new containers to Shipwreck and Sea Fort generation. Locker and Console containers are fixed and cannot be moved like Wood Crates. We will also be expanding these with craftable storage like woven baskets and a few more types of containers that you can find by exploring now that the new Storage system is completed.

- Removed [b]Discovery Fog.[/b]
The Discovery Fog has been a polarizing feature. Some players liked it, others disliked it, others didn’t mind it and it just plain confused the rest. It did serve a technical purpose to hide un-generated islands and their billboards suddenly popping in. It also helped performance by having less billboards on-screen, however once you’ve discovered the islands in the area around you they all end up being drawn anyway. In any case, the feature has been removed. Now we generate the billboards as soon as a zone is visible and we’ve also added a Billboard Density setting to control the quality and amount of billboards generated for a zone for different systems. Further optimizations to this will be coming with our work on bringing back the infinite generation.
